--- page 2 ---
Intro At a glance Models Colors/Features Specifications Accessories Important info
Your peace of mind
is top of mind.
The stylish exterior may be what catches your
eye, but it’s the dedication to safety and real-
world functionality that will hold your attention.
Every Traverse includes Chevy Safety Assist,1
a comprehensive suite of six driver assistance
features that includes Automatic Emergency
Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Lane Keep
Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Forward
Collision Alert, IntelliBeam® and Following
Distance Indicator. A choice of seating for seven
or eight 2 and best-in-class 98.2 cubic feet of
cargo space 3, 4 provide the flexibility to handle
just about any situation. When you’re on the go,
you’re surrounded by exceptional connectivity
and convenience features.
Prepare to take on the day in the 2023 Traverse —
a midsize SUV for a full-size life.
Traverse Premier in Iridescent Pearl Tricoat (extra-cost color).
1 Safety or driver assistance features are no substitute for the driver’s responsibility to operate the vehicle in a safe manner. Read the vehicle Owner’s Manual for important feature limitations and information. 2 Seating for eight is standard on LS; available
on LT. RS, Premier and High Country seat seven. 3 With second- and third-row seats folded flat. Cargo and load capacity limited by weight and distribution. 4 Based on latest available competitive information.
